title: 第一卷 第7章 逃离国都第一卷 第8章 敕妖咒
content_zh:
“你以为你逃得了？！”
王右思脸色难看，怒吼起来。
碾压之局，却几次三番被林辰化解，而此刻林辰更是站在了城门口！
虽然依旧有守城将士阻挡林辰，林辰想冲出去绝不容易。
但他这个守城大将已经颜面尽失！
他绝不允许再有任何意外，不论如何，他都必须亲手斩杀林辰！
剑意入震剑！
王右思眼中厉芒跳动，再不顾其它，狠狠斩出一剑，巨大剑芒凝实无比，空气都微微扭曲，好像要被震散一般！
这一剑正对着林辰，正对着城门！
除非林辰放弃逃跑，否则没有避开的可能性！
而一旦避了，金甲守卫合围而至，林辰插翅难飞！
“还不死？！”
王右思嘶吼，不断将剑意灌入这一剑，如此威能，岂是林辰能够抵挡？
林辰在门洞中有限的空间内，奋力做出闪避，避免正对那锋芒，但即便是边缘的杀伤，依旧可以让他瞬间死亡！
这是让人绝望的一幕。
但林辰没有放弃，他绝不能死在这里，他必须抓住任何一丝可能性。
剑意！
林辰眸中光芒猛地暴涨，他曾经也是凝意境的武者，很清楚剑意是何种力量，此刻王右思爆发的剑意的确强大，但，却出现了一丝滞涩！
王右思失误了吗？
剑招没有达到圆满，竟留下了破绽！

九天斩神诀！
给我开！
林辰咆哮，不计后果的爆发，丹田中那道剑影大放光芒，所有力量全部投入到天钨之中！
天钨化黑龙！
王右思这一剑的微小破绽，林辰，将之牢牢抓住！
王右思只是冷笑。
霸罡境的武者再如何疯狂提升力量，又怎么可能抵挡凝意境的全力一击？
果然，他接着就看到了林辰吐血倒飞，浑身血肉被长剑切割，伤口纵横，血水飞溅，已经成了一个血人！
大量尸体被斩飞，重重落地，虽然误杀了不少守城将士，但林辰死了，那就够了！
今日的闹剧，在此终结！
“叛国之贼，伏诛！”
王右思冷笑，高声大喝。
叮铃哐啷。
content_en:
"You think you can escape?!"
Wang Yousi looked ugly and roared angrily.
The crushing situation was resolved by Lin Chen several times, and now Lin Chen was standing at the gate of the city!
Although there were still soldiers blocking Lin Chen, it was not easy for Lin Chen to rush out.
But he, the general who defended the city, had lost all face!
He will never allow any more accidents. No matter what, he must kill Lin Chen with his own hands!
The sword intention enters the shaking sword!
The sharp light in Wang Yousi's eyes jumped, and without caring about anything else, he slashed out with a sword. The huge sword light was so solid that the air was slightly distorted, as if it was about to be shaken away!
This sword is facing Lin Chen, facing the city gate!
Unless Lin Chen gives up escaping, there is no possibility of avoiding it!
But once he escaped, the golden-armored guards surrounded him, making it difficult for Lin Chen to fly!
"Still dead?!"
Wang Yousi roared, constantly pouring sword intent into this sword. How could Lin Chen resist such power?
Lin Chen struggled to dodge in the limited space in the doorway to avoid facing the sharp edge, but even the edge damage could still kill him instantly!
This is a desperate scene.
But Lin Chen didn't give up. He must not die here. He must seize any possibility.
Sword intent!
The light in Lin Chen's eyes suddenly surged. He was once a warrior in the Condensation Realm, and he knew very well what kind of power the sword intention was. The sword intention that Wang Yousi exploded at this moment was indeed powerful, but there was a hint of stagnation!
Did Wang Yousi make a mistake?
The sword move did not reach perfection and actually left flaws!
Nine Heavens God-killing Technique!
Open it for me!
Lin Chen roared, recklessly erupting, the sword shadow in his dantian shined brightly, and all his power was put into the tungsten!
Tungsten transforms into a black dragon!
Lin Chen grasped the tiny flaw in Wang Yousi's sword!
Wang Yousi just sneered.
No matter how the warriors in the Ba Gang Realm crazily increase their strength, how can they withstand the full blow of Ning Yi Jing?
Sure enough, he then saw Lin Chen vomiting blood and flying backwards. His flesh and blood were cut by the sword, with wounds crisscrossing and blood splashing. He had become a bloody man!
A large number of corpses were chopped away and landed heavily on the ground. Although many soldiers who defended the city were accidentally killed, it was enough if Lin Chen died!
Today's farce ends here!
"The treasonous traitors shall be punished!"
Wang Yousi sneered and shouted loudly.
The bell clangs.
